migration_note: Compatibility registry. Canonical target is registry/program/index.json plus immutable records.

program.mission: Build a provider-aware, evidence-driven, scalable and increasingly autonomous global collectibles intelligence operating system under the 120 Standard.

tracks.role: PoC intelligence producer and current-readiness measurement
Independent validation before market-data spend and Production promotion
Published-snapshot consumer, presentation layer and Portal QA
Runtime, deployment, monitoring, recovery and rollback of approved intelligence

operating_principles: One Program. One Language. One Registry. One Source of Truth.
Structure is stable; intelligence is dynamic.
Generate, validate, approve and publish are separate responsibilities.
Portal renders published intelligence and does not calculate it.
Track D operates approved intelligence and does not approve Production.
No material doctrine is official when it exists only inside a chat session.
Current measurements are conditional and do not claim permanent superiority.
